author.name: Naval Ravikant
author.heading: About Naval Ravikant
author.bio: Naval Ravikant co-founded the consumer-review company Epinions and the startup-investment platform AngelList. His How to Get Rich interviews with fellow founder Nivi turn that business experience into arguments about ownership, cooperation and personal freedom.

cite.sourceCitation: Ravikant, Naval, with Nivi. “Escape Competition Through Authenticity”. Naval, 2019-05-16. Edited online interview transcript.

copyAttribution: Naval Ravikant — published as a heading in the official 2019-05-16 edited interview, Escape Competition Through Authenticity. Earlier tweet date not established here.

context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: In the interview, Ravikant argues that competing for the same status rewards can pull people toward imitation. His alternative is to build something that expresses their particular strengths, while still checking whether customers actually want it.
